_: The 18 locked Muni Kids picks for the /drops/muni-kids-10-years rebuild.
_verified: Every price read from munikids.com on 20 September 2026 via /products/<handle>.js, which is the only endpoint that exposes inventory_policy and inventory_quantity per variant.
_stock_warning: products.json reports 300 of 350 products 'available'. That number is misleading. Most of the catalogue runs inventory_policy:'continue' at zero or NEGATIVE inventory_quantity, which on any other store would mean overselling. Here it does not: the product pages state 'MADE TO ORDER - MADE IN COLLABORATION X REINLAND GOLF CO.' So mode:'made-to-order' below is a fact about how the brand works, not a stock failure, and the post must say so plainly rather than implying same-day shipping OR implying sold out.
_fields: [slug, name, category, price_usd, mode, product_url, image_url]
_currency: USD, read from the brand's own US storefront. Nothing converted.

facts.founders: Brothers Maxton Reinland and Drew Reinland
facts.anniversary_note: Their own press release, dated June 2025, is headed 'Muni Kids Celebrates 10 Years'. 2015 + 10 = 2025, so the anniversary falls mid-year and they are ELEVEN as of September 2026. The page being replaced said 'Turns 11' in its title, 'Ten Years of the Muni Kids Program' in a section head, and '10-years' in its slug. All three could not be right, and there is no entity called the 'Muni Kids Program' anywhere in their material. Use eleven.
facts.junior_golf: Brand states it donates 3% of annual sales to junior golf programs.
facts.drew_role: Co-founder and creative director; headcovers, canvas art, children's books.
facts.books: Golforia Hole 1: The Lost City of Etiquette; Golforia Hole 2: Honest Hills Manor (new); Muni Kids Magic World of Golf. All $30.
facts.shop: Neighborhood Golf Shop, 499 SE 2nd Ave, Portland OR 97214, inside the Memory Den. NOTE: the brand's own About page still says 'Alberta Street', which is out of date — the shop's own site and its Yelp listing both give 499 SE 2nd Ave. Do not repeat Alberta Street. Shop hours are published but the shop site carries a 2023 copyright, so hours are not printed here.
facts.shop_scope: Vintage golf clothing and clubs, streetwear, collectables; lessons, club repair, fittings. Sits inside the Memory Den alongside other vintage vendors.
facts.made_to_order: Headcovers carry the line 'MADE TO ORDER - MADE IN COLLABORATION X REINLAND GOLF CO.' Reinland Golf Co. is the brothers' separate venture (reinlandgolfco.com).
facts.catalogue_size: 350 products listed at time of writing.

quotes._rule: Verbatim only. All four below are from the press release published on the brand's OWN about-us page, and must be attributed as the brand's own statement — not as an interview TGI conducted.
